events.name: Balboa Park December Nights
events.note: The city's largest free holiday festival.
events.description: The City of San Diego's largest free holiday festival fills Balboa Park with lights, live entertainment on public stages and food from around the world. It draws more than 350,000 people over two days.

events.name: La Jolla Christmas Parade & Holiday Festival
events.place: Parade starts Kline & Girard; festival at La Jolla Rec Center
events.description: The 70th annual La Jolla Christmas Parade kicks off at 1 p.m., followed by a holiday festival at the La Jolla Rec Center with Santa visits and a Christmas market. Sponsors help keep it a free community tradition.

events.name: San Diego Bay Parade of Lights
events.description: About 80 decorated boats parade along the San Diego bayfront and turn toward Coronado on two December evenings. There is no cost to view.

events.name: Cabrillo Open Military Bunker
events.note: Saturdays, conditions permitting. Park entry fee applies.
events.description: Volunteers bring Point Loma's WWII coastal defenses to life on the only days visitors can tour the bunkers. See the weapons and instruments that protected the coast; closed in inclement weather.

events.name: Old Point Loma Lighthouse Open Tower Day
events.note: Half-hour guided tours; same-day tickets, first come.
events.description: Climb to the top of the Old Point Loma Lighthouse on a half-hour guided tour marking the anniversary of its first lighting. These tours are the only way to reach the top of the tower.

events.name: Guided Bird Watching at Cabrillo
events.place: Cabrillo NM tidepool parking lot one
events.description: Join park staff for a one-mile birding hike on the coastal trail at Cabrillo, a Pacific Flyway hotspot. All ages and experience levels are welcome.

events.name: The Story of Cabrillo Ranger Walk
events.description: A 30-minute ranger walk introducing Juan Rodríguez Cabrillo's 1542 expedition, the Old Point Loma Lighthouse and how the monument grew.

events.name: Encinitas Holiday Street Fair
events.description: A holiday tradition since 1989 with children's rides, two stages of live entertainment, and food and drink.

events.name: Liberty Station Tree Lighting
events.description: Liberty Station's Salute the Season main event, a tree lighting and holiday festivities in the North Promenade.

events.name: Julian Country Christmas & Tree Lighting
events.note: Mountain town about an hour from San Diego.
events.description: Julian kicks off the season by lighting the town's huge living Christmas tree at Pioneer Park, with visits with Santa.

events.name: Surfin' Santa Arrival
events.description: Santa arrives at Seaport Village with a parade along the boardwalk, live music, street performers and photo ops.

events.name: Coronado Holiday Parade
events.place: Ferry Landing to Hotel del Coronado
events.description: Live music, business open houses, singalongs, a parade down Orange Avenue and a grand tree lighting at Rotary Park.

events.name: Liberty Station Menorah Lighting
events.description: A public menorah lighting for the first night of Hanukkah, with the Chabads of Downtown San Diego and Pacific Beach.

events.name: Starlight Parade & Festival
events.description: Ride Santa's Holiday Train through downtown Chula Vista, shop a holiday market, enjoy live music in Memorial Park and get a free family photo with Santa.

events.name: Little Italy Tree Lighting
events.description: Little Italy lights its 25-foot tower of 1,100 poinsettias, with festive decorations and live music.

events.name: Pacific Beach Holiday Parade
events.description: Pacific Beach Holiday Parade at Pacific Beach, San Diego. Free to watch.

events.name: Mission Bay Christmas Boat Parade of Lights
events.description: Mission Bay Christmas Boat Parade of Lights at Mission Bay, San Diego. Free.

events.name: Spreckels Organ 112th Birthday Concert
events.description: Spreckels Organ 112th Birthday Concert at Spreckels Organ Pavilion, Balboa Park. Free.

events.name: North Park Coffee & Tea Fair
events.place: North Park Mini Park, San Diego
events.description: North Park Coffee & Tea Fair at North Park Mini Park, San Diego. Free.

events.name: 45th San Diego MLK Parade
events.description: 45th San Diego MLK Parade at Harbor Dr, San Diego. Free.

events.name: Holiday Marketplace at Mission Trails
events.place: Mission Trails Regional Park Visitor Center, 1 Father Junipero Serra Trail
events.description: A holiday shopping event at the Mission Trails visitor center that benefits the park.

events.name: Free Family Fun Day – Mission Valley Community Market
events.description: A free Mission Valley community market morning with family activities.

events.name: San Diego Made Holiday Market
events.place: NTC Park at Liberty Station, 2455 Cushing Rd
events.description: A Small Business Saturday market with over 175 local San Diego makers in NTC Park at Liberty Station.

events.name: Book Lovers Holiday Market
events.place: Liberty Public Market, 2820 Historic Decatur Rd
events.description: A one-day celebration of books and small shops at Liberty Public Market, presented by You Should Read.

events.name: Unleash the Holiday Cheer!
events.place: NTC Park at Liberty Station, 2455 Cushing Rd
events.description: The 11th annual family- and pet-friendly holiday party with dog adoptions, crafts, treats, live music and Santa.

events.name: Holiday Lights in Downtown El Cajon
events.description: A free downtown holiday festival with a bubble Snow Zone, live music, kids' train rides, Santa photos and an artisan market, ending with a 6pm tree lighting.

events.name: Harney Street Market
events.place: Harney St between San Diego Ave and Congress St, Old Town
events.description: A weekend artisan market in Old Town with jewelry, photography, pottery, clothing, paintings, glass and woodworking.

events.name: San Diego Ramen Festival
events.place: Handlery Hotel San Diego, 950 Hotel Circle N
events.description: A ticketed ramen tasting festival in Mission Valley.

events.name: North Park Winter Fair
events.description: An artisan marketplace with seasonal food and drinks, a Santa photo station and holiday fun.

events.name: Kensington Holiday Lights Bike Ride
events.description: The Kensington Community Association's annual ride through the neighborhood's holiday lights. Decorate your bike and join in.

events.name: Guided Walking Tour of Cabrillo
events.place: Cabrillo National Monument Visitor Center, Point Loma
events.description: A park volunteer leads a one-hour walk past the Cabrillo statue and up the hill to the Old Point Loma Lighthouse. Suitable for all ages; meet in front of the visitor center.
events.note: Saturdays, 11am and 1pm. No reservations. Park entry fee applies.

events.name: Makers Arcade Holiday Fair
events.description: A two-day holiday fair with 150+ local artists, makers and small businesses, live music, a wreath make-and-take station, food trucks, hot cocoa and bars, run by a San Diego nonprofit.
events.note: Stay on the pier Sunday evening to watch the Parade of Lights.

events.name: Holiday in the Village (La Mesa)
events.place: La Mesa Blvd between Spring St and 4th St, La Mesa
events.description: La Mesa Village's holiday street festival with 100+ vendors, an ice skating rink, mini golf, a Santa experience and an elf scavenger hunt along La Mesa Boulevard.

events.name: Spreckels Organ Sunday Concert
events.description: A free one-hour concert on the world's largest outdoor pipe organ, played every Sunday year-round at Balboa Park's Spreckels Organ Pavilion.
events.note: Every Sunday at 2pm, rain or shine. Free; first-come seating.
know: Free parking up to 3 hours in the Lower Inspiration Point lot, with a free shuttle.

events.name: Trail Tykes at Mission Trails
events.place: Mission Trails Regional Park Visitor Center, 1 Father Junipero Serra Trail
events.description: A nature program for toddlers and pre-K kids and their families, with a read-aloud story plus a craft, activity or short walk.

events.name: 2027 San Diego Brew Fest
events.place: Liberty Station NTC Park, 2455 Cushing Rd
events.description: More than 70 breweries pouring 200 beers, plus food trucks, lawn games and cover bands at Liberty Station.
